Question 1
?

What is the trace in the yz-plane of the hyperbolic cylinder (x−4)22−(y+1)27=1?

a
The line y=−1
b
The hyperbola (y+1)27−z2=1
c
The line y=6
d
The ellipse (y+1)27+z22=1
e
The lines y=−8 and y=6
